Dear [Mr Macmillan](../persons.html#939)
Please let me have the rest of the [Primer](../books.html#353) I thought I had it all, but I cannot find further than what I send.
I am waiting for [Mr Freeman](../persons.html#523)’s orders before I send back [the French history](../books.html#99)

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: Black-edged paper.
